description: Copies the style (Props) — and optionally the size — of a single element into the static WireframeClipboard. Unlike the other wireframe commands it does not implement IWireframeCommand and has no Undo(), because it changes no document state; execute it directly instead of pushing it onto a command stack.

members.name: CopyStyleCommand
members.description: Creates the command for the element to copy from.

members.name: Execute
members.description: Stores the element's style props (and size when includeSize is true) in WireframeClipboard.
